RCEP原产货物与运输条件
RCEP第三章规定原产资格、累积、产品特定规则和直接运输等要求，享惠应结合进口方实施安排与商品税则。
RCEP Chapter 3 defines originating goods, cumulation and associated operational conditions. Preferential treatment requires the relevant product-specific rule and importing-party implementation, not merely a Chinese shipping address.
Keywords: RCEP, 原产地, 累积, 直接运输, 零关税, origin
